text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
All checked and good to go!
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Curren & Fine
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~!
Thank you very much.

Today, I was doing a photoshoot for a fashion magazine.
Apparently, they're doing a special feature on Beauty Anshinzawa.
So, they ended up publishing photos of Curren Chan and Fine Motion wearing the racing outfits she designed.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Curren-chan adjusts her poses and expressions instantly—she's truly amazing~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe♪ You really seem used to being photographed too, Fine-san.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Do you two have a moment?
We're planning to shoot outside next,
so which of these spots do you think is best?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Waaah, everywhere looks so photogenic, it's hard to choose.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! This park looks great!
The flowers in the flowerbed are so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, if it's here...
Curren agrees too!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
It's so colorful, the photos will look great!
Let's go with this one!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hey, Curren-chan. How are you planning on having your photos taken at the park?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I do have a concept in mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! I just had a feeling
you'd plan something that matches the scenery perfectly,
Curren-chan!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You were coming up with your own themes for the poses in the shoot earlier, right? What's the plan this time?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Well, I was thinking of making the most of black!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The moment I saw my Racewear, it just clicked♪
Because Beauty-san captured Curren's
cuteness perfectly in black.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So black is... a "cute" color in Curren-chan's eyes?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ For example... Onii-chan, what kind
of image comes to mind when you think of black?
choice_data_list: Black is a color that cannot be tainted by anything.
Black is a color that brings out the best in others.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ For example... Onee-chan, what kind
of image comes to mind when you think of black?
choice_data_list: Black is a color that cannot be tainted by anything.
Black is a color that brings out the best in others.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A color untainted by anything...
Yeah, that's so like Curren-chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe♪
The actual theme will be a surprise for the real thing!

Upon arriving at the park, the photoshoot began immediately.
First up is Curren Chan's solo shot.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Nice expression!
It's making my heart race!

Curren Chan posed freely as she pleased.
Her gestures and expressions seemed more mature than usual—
...Even the lovely flowers and tranquil scenery around us somehow feel bewitchingly vibrant.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Alright, cut!
Curren-chan, that was super cool!
I was so captivated by Curren Chan, who seemed different from usual, that the shoot ended before I knew it.
choice_data_list: It was like a pure black that couldn't be dyed by anything else!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪
You know, black is such a strong color.
So in Curren's eyes, it's the ultimate symbol of cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Black cannot be dyed by anything.
In fact, with its sheer intensity,
it can completely transform the atmosphere around it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Take the ribbon on this racing attire, for example.
Even a soft, sweet pink looks pretty cool when paired with black, right?"

Her words reminded me of how vivid and enchanting
the scenery felt while photographing her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The unshakeable strength of black.
To Curren, that's what's "cute."

A black that dyes even the surrounding atmosphere in her own color.
That is why it serves as the absolute symbol of cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's super “cute”, right?♪

Thanks in part to Curren Chan's clear theme,
the published photos were a massive hit!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A color that brings out the best in others, huh...
Curren-chan definitely has a knack
for being a great support!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe♪
The actual theme will be a surprise for the real thing!

Upon arriving at the park, the photoshoot began immediately.
It's a two-shot photoshoot with Curren Chan and Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, both of you~!
It matches your outfit colors perfectly!

The two posed while keeping each other in mind.
With her outfit's aesthetic, Fine Motion looked just like a fairy frolicking among the flowers.
Curren Chan, on the other hand, showed a wide range of expressions—sometimes adorably fairy-like, other times completely cool and aloof.

"—The black makes a striking contrast amidst the vivid colors.
While complementing Fine Motion's outfit,
she doesn't lose any of her own presence."

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Okay, awesome!!
With colors popping like this, we gotta do a two-page spread!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like it turned out to be a great photo!
It's all thanks to your plan, Curren-chan.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The black color really brought out
my racing outfit and the flowers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Colors look much more vibrant against a black background♪
Besides, adding black tightens up the whole composition~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You thought that far ahead!
Black really has all kinds of effects, huh.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Black is a versatile color
that matches whatever you pair it with!
choice_data_list: Is being so versatile what you have in common with Curren's cuteness?
Versatility is what you have in common with Curren's cuteness?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yep♪ But being able to show all those different cute sides of Curren was thanks to Fine-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"You have a cuteness that is uniquely your own, Fine-san.
So I came up with a way to show off a different kind of cuteness."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
How to show off Curren's cuteness...
Black is proof that the choice was entrusted to Curren.
It suits Curren perfectly, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, absolutely!
That's a racing outfit only Curren-chan could pull off!

And a few days later, the vivid two-page spread photo of them
was met with rave reviews!
